entry.hypothesis: Names with >= 1 purchase filing and a 126-session net purchase ratio (P$ - S$)/(P$ + S$) >= 0.5 beat the basket; netting sales removes names insiders are also selling (PREREG H5).
entry.rationale: Lakonishok & Lee (2001) - aggregate net buying predicts returns; sales alone are noise (scheduled, option-related).

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
